title: Season-End Sales Returns
summary: Check every season-end return of seeds, crop protection products or seasonal stock against the original sale, the return policy and the schemes already paid on it.

seo.title: Season-End Sales Returns Reconciliation | VipraTech
seo.description: Check season-end returns from distributors and dealers against invoices, lots, return windows and caps, and reverse schemes paid on returned stock.

designed_for: CFO or Head of Sales Finance

problem.intro: Seed and crop protection companies, and seasonal businesses such as apparel, sell stock into the channel before the season and take back what does not sell. A weak or late monsoon can double the returns. Each return has to be checked against the lot that was sold, the return window, the policy and the schemes and discounts already paid on the original sale.

pain_points.title: Returns of stock never sold to that dealer
pain_points.detail: Lots and batches come back from a distributor who did not buy them, or in larger quantities than were sold.

pain_points.title: Schemes not reversed
pain_points.detail: Booking discounts, cash discounts and scheme payouts earned on the original sale stay paid after the stock comes back.

pain_points.title: Returns outside the window or the cap
pain_points.detail: Late returns and returns above the policy share of purchases are accepted because nobody checks each line.

pain_points.title: Lots that cannot be resold
pain_points.detail: Seed past its test validity, expired chemicals or damaged packs are credited at full price when the policy says otherwise.

solution.overview: VipraTech traces each returned lot or batch to the invoices that sold it to that distributor, checks the return window, the policy cap as a share of season purchases, the lot's validity and the condition recorded at the depot, and values the return at the billed price. It then finds every scheme, booking discount and cash discount paid on the returned quantity and calculates what should be reversed. Finance gets a credit note sheet net of reversals, and every line keeps its trace.
capabilities: Traces each returned lot or batch to the original invoices to that distributor
Checks the return window and the policy cap as a share of season purchases
Checks lot validity, expiry and the condition recorded at the depot
Finds schemes, booking discounts and cash discounts paid on returned stock and calculates the reversal
Credit note sheet net of reversals, with an exception queue for the rest
Season return report by distributor, product, region and reason

workflow.title: Receive returns
workflow.detail: Return requests and depot receipt notes are loaded with lot, quantity and condition.

workflow.title: Trace to sales
workflow.detail: Each lot is traced to the invoices that sold it to the distributor during the season.

workflow.title: Apply the policy
workflow.detail: Return window, cap and resaleability rules are applied, and the eligible quantity is set.

workflow.title: Reverse benefits
workflow.detail: Schemes and discounts paid on the returned quantity are calculated for reversal.

workflow.title: Review
workflow.detail: Lines outside policy or without a trace go to finance and sales with the reason.

workflow.title: Credit and report
workflow.detail: Finance approves the net credit note sheet, and each distributor gets a statement.

match_rules.logic: Every returned lot must trace to an invoice to the same distributor in the season. Quantity is capped at sold less earlier returns.
The return must reach the depot within the window the policy sets for that product and season.
Eligible returns stay within the cap set as a share of the distributor's season purchases.
Lot validity, expiry and the depot's condition note decide whether the return is credited in full, in part or not at all.
Schemes, booking discounts and cash discounts earned on the returned quantity are calculated and netted from the credit.

exception_codes.meaning: The lot was never invoiced to this distributor.
exception_codes.action: Reject, or ask where the stock came from.

exception_codes.meaning: Returned quantity is above what was sold, less earlier returns.
The return reached the depot after the window.
exception_codes.action: Reject, or approve with commercial sign-off.

exception_codes.meaning: Returns are above the policy share of season purchases.
exception_codes.action: Credit up to the cap. The rest needs sign-off.

exception_codes.meaning: The lot is past validity or damaged beyond the policy.
exception_codes.action: Credit at the policy rate for unsaleable stock.

exception_codes.meaning: Schemes or discounts paid on this stock have not been netted.
exception_codes.action: Net the reversal from the credit.

inputs: Return requests and depot receipt notes with lot numbers
Season sales invoices with lot or batch numbers
Return policy by product group and season
Scheme, booking discount and cash discount records
outputs: Return lines traced to invoices, with eligible quantities
Scheme and discount reversals for returned stock
Net credit note sheet for finance approval
Season return report by distributor, product and reason
human_in_the_loop: Finance and the commercial team decide every return outside policy. The system proposes reversals but finance approves each one before credit notes are raised.
integrations: ERP such as SAP or Tally for invoices, returns and credit notes
Depot or warehouse system for receipt notes
DMS or scheme register for payouts
Shared drive for the return policy
guardrails: No credit without a traced invoice for the lot
Caps and windows from the policy version for that season
Reversals shown line by line beside the credit
Claimed and eligible quantities shown side by side
compliance_notes: Sales return credit notes should reference the original invoice for GST; the trace keeps that link.
Scheme reversals keep trade spend accruals and revenue net of returns correct for the season close.

rollout.scope: Returns from the last season for one region or product group, with finance-settled returns as the benchmark.
deliverables: Return policy set up as rules
Returns traced to invoices, with exceptions

what_we_measure.how: Share of returned quantity matched to an invoice for the same lot.
Schemes and discounts still paid on returned stock.
Lines outside the window, cap or resaleability rules, confirmed by finance.

faqs.q: Our invoices do not always carry lot numbers. Does that work?
faqs.a: Yes. Where lots are missing, returns are matched on product, pack, quantity and date, and those matches are marked weaker so finance can decide how much evidence it needs.

faqs.q: Can it handle different policies for seeds and crop protection?
faqs.a: Yes. Windows, caps and resaleability rules are set per product group and season, and each return is judged by the rules for its own group.

faqs.q: Does it work for apparel sale-or-return?
faqs.a: Yes. Season, style and size replace lot numbers, and the same trace, cap and reversal checks apply.

faqs.q: Can it show returns risk before the season ends?
faqs.a: Yes. Channel stock and liquidation by distributor can be loaded during the season, so likely returns show up while there is still time to move stock.
